entries.Original:
Conditional element will serve as conditional trigger for any elements lower than this in current layout. 
If this element is visible, elements below will also be shown. If there are multiple sequential conditional elements, they will be merged using rules defined in the layout. This is advanced feature that allows displaying elements, for example, when a certain buff is present on a player, boss, allows drawing elements around players when boss is casting something, etc.

If another conditional element is encountered after normal element, it will be processed together with the rules defined in the layout. For example:
- if element structure is A1B2, where A and B - conditional elements, 1 and 2 - normal elements:
- - in OR mode if A is shown but B is hidden, both 1 and 2 will be shown; 
- - in AND mode - only 1 will be shown. 
- If A is hidden but B is shown:
- - OR mode will display only 2;
- - AND mode will display nothing at all. 

Conditional elements may serve as normal elements and display information on their own, or simply be hidden service elements.

Splatoon supports few renderers. On this page, you can select which ones you want to use, configure them and set one of them as default.
Render engine can be set globally and per-element. When set render engine is not available, either due to load error or because user has disabled it, other available render engine will be used automatically.
Settings present in this section affect all available renderes.

entries.Original: Defines primary color of the line.

Derives accent and background colors from element settings. Background will become more transparent than accent by this percentage. Background is capped at 0% alpha value, while accent is capped at 100%.
entries.Translated: 从元素设置中获取重音和背景颜色。背景将比重音更加透明，透明度增加百分比。背景的 alpha 值上限为 0%，而重音的 alpha 值上限为 100%。

entries.Original: How many segments there will be between accent pulses.
entries.Translated: 重音脉冲之间会有多少段落？

entries.Original: How many segments of accent color will be there.
entries.Translated: 那里会有多少段重音色呢？

entries.Original: How long (in segments) transition between accent and background will take.
entries.Translated: 从口音到背景音的转换需要多长时间 (以片段为单位)?

entries.Original: How fast color animation happens. Lower is faster. Set to 0 to completely disable color animation.
entries.Translated: 颜色动画发生的速度。越低越快。设置为 0 将完全禁用颜色动画。
从可信 URL 下载脚本......

entries.Original: This is the default configuration which can not be removed. Click to load/reload it.
entries.Translated: 这是无法删除的默认配置。点击加载/重新加载它。
将此配置复制到剪贴板

entries.Original: Click to apply this configuration and reload the script.
entries.Translated: 点击应用此配置并重新加载脚本。

entries.Original:
Non-restricted editing access. Any incorrectly performed changes may cause script to stop working completely. Use reset function if it happens. 
- In general, only edit color, thickness, text, size. 
- If script has it's own color settings, they will be prioritized.
- Not all script will take whatever you edit here into account.
entries.Translated:
非限制性编辑访问。任何不正确的更改都可能导致脚本完全停止工作。如果发生这种情况，请使用重置功能。
一般来说，只编辑颜色、厚度、文字和尺寸。
如果脚本有自己的颜色设置，它们将被优先考虑。
并非所有剧本都会考虑你在这里编辑的内容。

entries.Original: Reset selected elements and reload script
entries.Translated: 重置选定元素并重新加载脚本
将自定义设置导出到剪贴板 (已过时)

entries.Original: This exports both Elements and Layouts. Prefer exporting configuration in Saved configurations tab when possible.
entries.Translated: 这将导出 Elements 和 Layouts。如果可能，请在 Saved configurations 选项卡中导出配置。

entries.Original: Import customized settings from clipboard (hold CTRL+click)
entries.Translated: 从剪贴板导入自定义设置 (按住 CTRL+ 点击键)

entries.Original:
Import contains keys that were not registered by script.
Import blocked.
To override, hold CTRL+SHIFT while importing.
entries.Translated:
导入包含未通过脚本注册的密钥。
导入被阻止。
要覆盖，请在导入时按住 CTRL+SHIFT 键。

entries.Original:
Left-click - set player name. 
Right-click - set player name and job.
entries.Translated:
左键单击——设置玩家名称。
右键单击——设置玩家名称和职业。
删除此优先级列表 (保留 CTRL)

entries.Original: Can't validate list: there are less than
This list matches your current party.
entries.Translated: 这个列表与当前派对相符。

entries.Original: However, one of previous lists also match your current party, so this list will never be selected.
entries.Translated: 然而，之前的一个列表也与你当前的队伍相匹配，所以这个列表永远不会被选中。

entries.Original: Alias should start with a slash /
The default type for new elements. No cast animation is specified.
entries.Translated: 新元素的默认类型。未指定投射动画。

entries.Original: Pulse with some frequency. This looks similar to the game's default VFX.
entries.Translated: 以一定频率脉冲。这看起来类似于游戏的默认 VFX。

entries.Original: Change the element's color based on the cast progress.
entries.Translated: 根据铸造进度更改元素的颜色。

entries.Original: Fill the element from start to end based on the cast progress.
entries.Translated: 根据铸造进度从头到尾填充元素。

entries.Original: The default type for new elements. Use this if none of the other types make sense.
entries.Translated: 新元素的默认类型。如果其他类型都不合理，可以使用这个。

entries.Original: Danger zones. Typically this is avoidable AOE damage.
entries.Translated: 危险区域。通常情况下，这是可以避免的 AOE 损害。

entries.Original: Safe zones. This zone should be safe from avoidable damage.
entries.Translated: 安全区。这个区域应该是安全的，不会受到可以避免的损坏。

entries.Original: Soakable damage zones. Typically this is unavoidable AOE damage such as stacks, towers, or defamations.
entries.Translated: 可浸水损坏区域。通常，这是不可避免的自然灾害损坏，例如堆栈、塔楼或诽谤。

entries.Original: Gaze zones. When in the zone or tethered you must look away from the origin.
entries.Translated: 注视区域。当处于注视区域或被拴住时，必须将目光从源头移开。

entries.Original: Knockback zones. When in the zone you will be pushed. Should be paired with a Knockback tether.
entries.Translated: 敲击区域。当你进入该区域时，你将被推动。应配备敲击绳。

entries.Original: Useful information without an associated hazard.
entries.Translated: 有用的信息，没有相关风险。

entries.Original: This render engine can not be disabled.
entries.Translated: 这个渲染引擎不能被禁用。

entries.Original: All drawings, unless overriden per element, will be drawn using this render engine.
entries.Translated: 除非每个元素都被覆盖，否则所有绘图都将使用这个渲染引擎绘制。

entries.Original: You have disabled this render engine. However, until you restart Splatoon or game, it will remain loaded but inactive.
entries.Translated: 您已经禁用了这个渲染引擎。然而，在您重新启动 Splatoon 或游戏之前，它将保持加载状态但处于非活动状态。

entries.Original: Render engine was disabled by user.
In order to use this render engine again, you must enable it and restart Splatoon or game.
entries.Translated: 要再次使用这个渲染引擎，你必须启用它并重启 Splatoon 或游戏。

entries.Original: An error occurred during loading this render engine.
entries.Translated: 在加载这个渲染引擎时发生了错误。

entries.Original: Any draw calls directed to this render engine will be redirected to either default render engine or ImGui Legacy engine.
entries.Translated: 任何针对这个渲染引擎的绘制调用都将重定向到默认渲染引擎或 ImGui Legacy 引擎。

entries.Original:
open Splatoon configuration menu 
/splatoon toggle <PresetName> → toggle specified preset 
/splatoon disable <PresetName> → disable specified preset 
/splatoon enable <PresetName> → enable specified preset
/splatoon p → open script priority editor
entries.Translated:
打开 Splato 配置菜单
/splatoon 切换 <PresetName> → 指定的预设切换
/splatoon 禁用<PresetName>→禁用指定预设
/splatoon 启用 <PresetName> → 启用指定预设
/splatoon p → 开放脚本优先编辑器
突出显示包含特定短语的对象

entries.Original: Splatoon - Can not confirm compatibility with current game version
entries.Translated: Splatoon - 无法确认与当前游戏版本的兼容性

entries.Original: This version of Splatoon plugin is marked as revoked.
entries.Translated: 这个版本的 Splatoon 插件被标记为已撤销。

entries.Original:
Loading and using this version may lead to game crashes, 
data corruption or other unpredictable consequences.
entries.Translated:
加载和使用此版本可能导致游戏崩溃，
数据损坏或其他不可预测的后果。

entries.Original:
Usually there is already updated version that fixes the problem,
or it will be released very soon.
entries.Translated:
通常已经有更新版本可以解决这个问题，
或者很快就会发布。

entries.Original:
Splatoon could not connect to the GitHub to verify
if it could be running on current game version.
entries.Translated:
Splatoon 无法连接 GitHub 进行验证
如果它可以在当前游戏版本上运行。

entries.Original:
If the game has just updated, please test if the plugin works fine and if it does,
press "Load Splatoon and never display this window until next game update" 
button in this window next time you start the game.
entries.Translated:
如果游戏刚刚更新，请测试插件是否正常工作，如果正常，
点击 “加载 Splatoon，在下次游戏更新之前绝不显示此窗口”。
下次开始游戏时，请按下此窗口中的按钮。

entries.Original:
There is no information about compatibility of current version of
Splatoon with current version of the game.
entries.Translated:
没有关于当前版本的兼容性信息
使用当前版本游戏的 Splatoon。

entries.Original:
You may try to load plugin and continue using it. 
On a smaller patches it will usually work, but it may crash your game
in which case please wait for an update.
entries.Translated:
你可以尝试加载插件并继续使用它。
在较小的补丁上，它通常能正常工作，但可能会导致你的游戏崩溃。
如果是这样，请稍候更新。

entries.Original:
An update for Splatoon is available. 
Please open plugin installer and update Splatoon plugin.
entries.Translated:
关于 Splatoon 的更新可用。
请打开插件安装程序并更新 Splatoon 插件。
无论如何都要加载 Splatoon

entries.Original: Load Splatoon and never display this window until next game update
entries.Translated: 加载 Splato 并且在下次游戏更新之前永远不要显示此窗口

entries.Original: Join discord to be notified for update immediately.
entries.Translated: 加入不和谐，立即收到更新通知。

entries.Original: Please do not stream with third party tools visible.
entries.Translated: 请不要使用可见的第三方工具进行直播。

entries.Original: Normally, most of plugins are completely safe to use. Square Enix will not be able to detect their usage.
entries.Translated: 通常，大多数插件都是完全安全的。Square Enix 将无法检测到它们的使用。

entries.Original: However, streaming with third party tools visible may result in consequences.
entries.Translated: 然而，使用可见的第三方工具进行直播可能会导致后果。

entries.Original:
Regardless of how innocent a plugin or modification might be, it IS a violation of FFXIV's terms of service.
This includes not only third party tools, but also official Dalamud plugins, Advanced Combat Tracker and visual mods as well.
entries.Translated:
无论插件或修改可能多么无害，它都违反了 FFXIV 的服务条款。
这不仅包括第三方工具，还包括官方 Darumud 插件、高级战斗跟踪器和可视化模块。

entries.Original:
If you intended to stream your game, absolutely make sure that your plugins
and other third party tools are NOT VISIBLE ON STREAM.
entries.Translated:
如果你打算直播游戏，一定要确保你的插件
其他第三方工具在直播中不可见。

entries.Original: And it does not matters how many viewers you have - even just one is already enough.
entries.Translated: 无论你有多少观众，即使只有一个也足够了。

entries.Original: I understand and will not stream with third party tools visible
entries.Translated: 我理解，我不会用可见的第三方工具进行流式传输。

entries.Original:
You are seeing this message because a streaming software has been detected.
You will not see it again in your current game session.
entries.Translated:
您看到这条消息是因为检测到了流式处理软件。
您将不会在当前游戏环节再次看到它。
永远不要再显示这条信息

entries.Original: If you like Splatoon, you may consider contributing in any following way:
entries.Translated: 如果你喜欢 Splatoon，可以考虑以下任何一种贡献方式：

entries.Original: - Contributing combat data of new battles
entries.Translated: 贡献新战役的战斗数据

entries.Original: When a new battle comes, I would greatly benefit from obtaining it's combat data. If you are doing these battles early and wish to contribute combat data, please contact me via Discord to receive instructions on how to do so.
entries.Translated: 当新的战斗来临时，我将从获取战斗数据中受益匪浅。如果您正在进行这些战斗并希望提供战斗数据，请通过 Discord 联系我，以获取如何进行的指导。

entries.Original: - Sending your own presets to public
entries.Translated: - 将你自己的预设发送给公众

entries.Original: Did Splatoon helped you to clear a raid, to resolve a mechanic, to improve your gameplay in any way? Please consider submitting your preset to the public so others may enjoy it as well!
entries.Translated: Splatoon 是否帮助你通关了一次突袭，解决了一个机制，或者以任何方式提高了你的游戏玩法？请考虑将你的预设版本提交给公众，这样其他人也可以享受它！

entries.Original: You may send it to Github if you have account or to my Discord server.
entries.Translated: 如果您有账号，可以将其发送到 Github 或我的 Discord 服务器。

entries.Original: - Adding a star to the repo
Don't have any presets to send? You may still help by simply adding a star to Splatoon and my plugins' repo!
entries.Translated: 没有任何预设要发送吗？你仍然可以帮忙，只需要在 Splatoon 和我的插件代码库中添加一颗星就行了！

entries.Original: To do so, all you need is Github account. After logging in, proceed to the links below and click "Star" button in top right corner of the page.
entries.Translated: 要做到这一点，你只需要一个 Github 账号。登录后，转到下面的链接，点击页面右上角的 “Star” 按钮。

entries.Original: If you would like to financially support me, you may use Patreon, Ko-Fi or cryptocurrency. Financial support allows me to put extra time into plugin!
entries.Translated: 如果你想在经济上支持我，你可以使用 Patreon、Ko-Fi 或加密货币。经济支持让我能在插件上投入额外的时间！

entries.Original: Add my hitbox value to distance calculation
entries.Translated: 将我的 Hitbox 值添加到距离计算中

entries.Original: Add target's hitbox value to distance calculation
entries.Translated: 在距离计算中添加目标的 Hitbox 值

entries.Original: Duration in seconds to display frozen elements.
entries.Translated: 显示冻结元素的持续时间 (单位：秒)。

entries.Original:
Interval in seconds between creation of new frozen elements.
A lower number means more elements spawned.
entries.Translated:
创造新的冻结元素之间的间隔 (以秒为单位)。
数量越少，意味着产生的元素越多。

entries.Original: Warning: your interval between freezes is very low. Please ensure that this is intentional.
entries.Translated: 警告：您的冻结间隔时间非常短。请确保这是有意为之。

entries.Original: The delay in seconds before a newly created frozen element will be displayed.
entries.Translated: 将显示新创建的冻结元素前几秒钟的延迟。
玩家的任务与这个选择相匹配

entries.Original: Player's job does not matches this selection
entries.Translated: 玩家的任务与此选择不匹配

entries.Original: Hold CTRL + left click to delete
entries.Translated: 按住 Ctrl + 左键点击以删除
不区分大小写 (部分) 的消息

entries.Original: Switch all displayed layouts/scripts to configuration, if supported:
entries.Translated: 如果支持，将所有显示的布局/脚本切换到配置：

entries.Original: Right click to bring context menu.
entries.Translated: 右键点击以显示上下文菜单。

entries.Original: Import multiple presets with ease by simply copying them. Splatoon will read your clipboard and attempt to import whatever you copy. Your clipboard will be cleared upon enabling.
entries.Translated: 轻松导入多个预设，只需复制它们即可。Splatoon 会读取您的剪贴板并尝试导入您复制的任何内容。启用后，您的剪贴板将被清空。
Splatoon 可渲染区域选择器

entries.Original: Invalid configuration. Your settings will be ignored
entries.Translated: 无效配置。您的设置将被忽略。

entries.Original: Your whole screen will be used to render Splatoon draws.
entries.Translated: 您的整个屏幕将用于渲染 Splatoon 绘图。

entries.Original: Thanks to all the people who have contributed to Splatoon! Here is the list of ones who contributed and wanted to be mentioned. Can't find yourself here/website link is wrong? Please open an issue on GitHub or Discord and I will add you. You can specify your name as well as your website/social network account, if you wish.
entries.Translated: 感谢所有为 Splatoon 做出贡献的人！以下是一份有贡献且希望被提及的人员名单。在这里找不到你/网站链接是错误的吗？请在 GitHub 或 Discord 上打开一个问题，我会添加你。如果你愿意，你可以指定你的名字以及你的网站/社交网络账号。

entries.Original: Warning, this list is under construction. Many people are missing here.
entries.Translated: 警告：这份名单正在建设中。许多人在这里失踪。

entries.Original: Don't auto-reset find on zone change
entries.Translated: 不要自动重置区域更改

entries.Original: Here is current list of searched objects:
entries.Translated: 以下是当前搜索对象的列表：

entries.Original: You are about to access EXTRAORDINARELY DANGEROUS OPTIONS. Normally, the ONLY time you'd want to use it if you are the developer.
entries.Translated: 你即将访问特别危险的选项。通常，如果你是开发者，这是你唯一想使用它的时候。

entries.Original: I understand that improper use of these functions may result in irrecoverable damages.
entries.Translated: 我理解，这些功能的不当使用可能会导致不可挽回的损害。

entries.Original: Add extra trusted sources from which you would like to import scripts. One per line. Any URL that starts with any of the lines you add will be considered trusted. You should choose wisely. Splatoon developers and publishers are NOT responsible for any possible damage that will happen to your game, characters, personal data, operating system, and PC if you will use this function incorrectly.
entries.Translated: 添加额外的可信来源，以便从中导入脚本。每行一个。任何以你添加的任何行开头的 URL 都将被视为可信的。你应该明智地做出选择。如果你不正确使用此功能，对你的游戏、角色、个人数据、操作系统和 PC 可能造成的任何损害，Splatoon 开发者和发布者概不负责。

entries.Original: In addition to official Splatoon repo, Splatoon will check scripts for updates from the following lists, one per line. WARNING. By adding an extra list here you will allow maintainer of such list to run ANY CODE ON YOUR COMPUTER, without any restrictions. Splatoon developers and publishers are NOT responsible for any possible damage that will happen to your game, characters, personal data, operating system, and PC if you will use this function incorrectly.
entries.Translated: 除了官方的 Splatoon 仓库外，Splatoon 还将检查以下列表中的脚本更新，每行一个。警告：通过在这里添加额外的列表，您将允许该列表的维护者在您的计算机上运行任何代码，不受任何限制。如果您不正确地使用此功能，Splatoon 开发者和发布者对您的游戏、角色、个人数据、操作系统和 PC 可能遭受的任何损害不负任何责任。

entries.Original: Workspace name. Just for your convenience, never exported.
entries.Translated: 工作场所名称。为方便起见，从未导出过。

entries.Original: Source and Target languages can not be the same!
entries.Translated: 源语言和目标语言不能相同！

entries.Original: Hold SHIFT and CTRL and click this button to permanently delete this workspace. Only do it after you have sent pull request or committed and pushed changes to the repository.
entries.Translated: 按住 SHIFT 和 CTRL，然后单击此按钮永久删除此工作区。仅在提交拉取请求或提交并推送更改到代码仓库后进行此操作。

entries.Original: Entered text will be used with game clients using language:
entries.Translated: 输入的文本将用于使用语言的游戏客户端：

entries.Original: . If empty, global value will be used. Global value is:
entries.Translated: 如果为空，将使用全局值。全局值为：

entries.Original:
Splatoon Projection allows you to see limited amount of attacks without having to import/create layouts.
- Likely only basic attacks will be shown
- Some attacks may be shown incorrectly, sometimes stuff that already telegraphed will be highlighted. It's strongly recommended to have a macro with "/splatoon pbl" command to instantly blacklist all currently displayed projected casts. Then you can send them to be included into plugin. 
- If a layout imported and enabled for current attack, it will not be processed by projection.
entries.Translated:
Splatoon Projection 允许您查看有限数量的攻击，而无需导入/创建布局。
可能只会展示基本攻击。
一些攻击可能会显示不正确，有时已经发送的内容会被突出显示。强烈建议使用一个带有 “/splatoon pbl” 命令的宏，立即将当前显示的所有投影角色列入黑名单。然后你可以将它们发送到插件中。
如果导入一个布局并为当前攻击启用，则不会通过投影进行处理。
默认情况下渲染展开投影

entries.Original:
Beta feature - may contain issues. Please proceed with caution, translate and submit PRs in small batches.
To begin working with translator, copy the text of the whole GitHub .md file and press "Import Page from Clipboard" button, or select previously imported page.
When you have finished translating, copy text with "Copy Result to Clipboard" button and submit a pull request to the original repository.
entries.Translated:
Beta 功能——可能包含问题。请谨慎进行，翻译并以小批量方式提交公关材料。
要开始使用翻译器，请复制整个 GitHub.md 文件的文本，然后点击 “从剪贴板导入页面” 按钮，或选择之前导入的页面。
完成翻译后，使用 “将结果复制到剪贴板” 按钮复制文本，并向原始仓库提交拉取请求。

entries.Original: The following scripts have been updated. Please check that your settings are intact, and if needed, reconfigure it.
entries.Translated: 以下脚本已更新。请检查您的设置是否完整，如有需要，请重新配置。

entries.Original: The following scripts have failed to load.
Please note that scripts have direct and unrestricted access to your PC and game. Ensure that you know what you're installing.
entries.Translated: 请注意，脚本可以直接且不受限制地访问您的 PC 和游戏。请确保您知道自己正在安装什么。

entries.Original: Enable this checkbox and click "Reload and Update" button to forcibly redownload all scripts, even should they have no updates, that were installed from the Internet.
entries.Translated: 启用此复选框并单击 “Reload and Update” 按钮，强制重新下载所有从互联网安装的脚本，即使它们没有更新。

entries.Original: Clears cache, recompiles and reloads all scripts and checks them for updates immediately.
entries.Translated: 清除缓存，重新编译和重新加载所有脚本，并立即检查是否有更新。

entries.Original: Installs script from clipboard. Your clipboard should contain either code of the script or link to a trusted URL (a script from Splatoon repository)
entries.Translated: 从剪贴板安装脚本。您的剪贴板应包含脚本的代码或可信 URL 的链接 (来自 Splatoon 仓库的脚本)。

entries.Original: Scripts are being installed, please wait...
entries.Translated: 脚本正在安装中，请稍等。
将脚本切换到配置描述文件

Splatoon - 检测到 Linux/Mac OS - 警告

entries.Original:
Linux or Mac OS environment detected and by default DirectX11 renderer was disabled due to crashing issues. 
If you wish, you can open Splatoon settings, go to "Render" tab to test it and reenable it if test succeeds. 
If it doesn't works for you, simply hide this window and use Legacy rendered.
entries.Translated:
检测到 Linux 或 Mac OS 环境，并且由于崩溃问题，DirectX11 渲染器默认被禁用。
如果您愿意，您可以打开 Splatoon 设置，前往 “Render” 选项卡进行测试，如果测试成功，则重新启用它。
如果这对您不起作用，只需隐藏此窗口并使用呈现的遗产即可。

entries.Original: You have entered a zone for which you have enabled scripts that use priority lists. If you have any priority lists set to "Placeholder" mode, please configure them here.
entries.Translated: 您已经进入了一个区域，其中您已经启用了使用优先级列表的脚本。如果您已经将任何优先级列表设置为 “占位符” 模式，请在此处配置它们。
